title: Calibration in One Go: Jointly Learning Accurate and Calibrated Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.13693v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural networks (NNs), while highly flexible and versatile, are often poorly calibrated. Post-hoc calibration methods adjust the outputs of an already trained model using a separate calibration dataset and additional calibration parameters. This process adds overhead that requires separate optimization of the calibrator and subsequent model selection. In this paper, we show that standard (post-hoc) calibrators can be trained end-to-end with the backbone via a bilevel Stackelberg formulation. This formulation eliminates the need for a separate calibration set or a dedicated calibration loss by jointly optimizing accuracy and calibration using cross-entropy, introducing only one additional hyperparameter: the calibrator learning rate. translated_title: 一步到位的校准：联合学习既准确又校准良好的神经网络
translated_abstract: 神经网络（NN）虽然具有高度的灵活性和通用性，但往往校准不佳。事后校准方法使用单独的校准数据集和额外的校准参数来调整已经训练好的模型的输出。这一过程增加了额外开销，需要对校准器进行单独优化以及后续的模型选择。在本文中，我们证明了标准的（事后）校准器可以通过双层 Stackelberg 公式与主干网络进行端到端联合训练。该公式通过使用交叉熵同时优化准确性和校准性能，消除了对单独校准集或专用校准损失函数的需求，仅引入了一个额外的超参数：校准器学习率。尽管我们的框架支持从温度缩放、矩阵缩放到神经网络层等各种校准器，但我们的结果表明，使用最终的分类层本身作为校准器即可得到既准确又校准良好的神经网络。
tldr: 该论文提出通过双层 Stackelberg 优化将校准器与主干网络端到端联合训练，无需单独的校准数据集或专用校准损失，仅引入校准器学习率这一个超参数，即可同时学习到既准确又校准良好的神经网络。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes jointly training calibrators with the backbone network end-to-end via a bilevel Stackelberg formulation, eliminating the need for a separate calibration set or dedicated calibration loss, and requiring only one additional hyperparameter (the calibrator learning rate) to learn both accurate and well-calibrated neural networks.
